title: Bounded refresh priority list excludes the bindings that need data most
problem_statement: resolve_bounded_source_refresh_active_symbols (scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh) previously only placed paper bindings with status==active into SOURCE_INGEST_ACTIVE_PAPER_SYMBOLS. A binding paused by a market_input_ reason code is exactly the one that needs the per-symbol monthly history path to accumulate closes, but it was excluded, causing a chicken-and-egg: the bounded deploy always failed with market_input_insufficient on first run.

deploy_nonprod_vm_sh.change: The embedded Python snippet now includes paper bindings whose status is 'paused' AND whose metadata.session_admission.reason_code starts with 'market_input_'. Bindings paused for any other reason remain excluded. Active bindings continue to be included. Symbol shape filter (.TW/.TWSE/.TWO/.TPEX) and paper deployment_mode filter are unchanged.

ac1_market_input_paused_included.criterion: the bounded refresh priority list includes a paper binding that is paused by a market input admission reason and not only bindings whose status is active
ac1_market_input_paused_included.evidence: test extracts resolver body from deploy script and asserts _MARKET_INPUT_PAUSE_PREFIX sentinel and paused-status logic branch are present

ac2_other_reason_excluded.criterion: a binding paused for any other reason is still excluded from the priority list
ac2_other_reason_excluded.evidence: test verifies reason_code.startswith(_MARKET_INPUT_PAUSE_PREFIX) guard is present so e.g. operator_requested_pause bindings are excluded

ac3_filters_unchanged.criterion: the Taiwan symbol shape filter and the paper deployment mode filter are unchanged
ac3_filters_unchanged.evidence: test asserts mode != 'paper' guard and re.fullmatch TWSE/TPEX pattern are still present in resolver

ac7_regression_tests.criterion: regression tests cover both the paused-for-market-input inclusion and the other-reason exclusion
ac7_regression_tests.evidence: test_bounded_refresh_includes_market_input_paused_bindings and test_bounded_refresh_excludes_other_reason_paused_bindings both pass; end-to-end snippet execution test test_bounded_refresh_priority_python_snippet_runs_correctly also passes with synthetic bindings covering active, market_input_paused, other_reason_paused, and non-paper bindings

ac4_per_symbol_monthly_history.criterion: one bounded refresh run yields at least two official closes for the prioritized symbol by reaching the per-symbol monthly history endpoint
ac4_per_symbol_monthly_history.note: Requires live Docker Compose + TWSE endpoint access on dev VM. Cannot be verified in local unit test. Reviewer should confirm via hosted dev deploy.

ac5_symbol_in_env_var.criterion: hosted dev shows the prioritized symbol inside SOURCE_INGEST_ACTIVE_PAPER_SYMBOLS during a bounded deploy
ac5_symbol_in_env_var.note: Requires live deploy on dev VM. Reviewer should confirm.

ac6_market_snapshot_two_closes.criterion: hosted dev serves a latest market snapshot for that symbol carrying at least two closes and official TWSE or TPEx lineage
ac6_market_snapshot_two_closes.note: Requires live deploy on dev VM. Reviewer should confirm.
